01 — INTRODUCTION

01 / THE PERSON

Curiosity with
direction.

I’m Divya Gupta, a BBA Digital Business & Entrepreneurship student at IIM Bangalore, with an interest in entrepreneurship, marketing and consulting.

My journey has been shaped by taking initiative early: hosting school events, representing students, coordinating cultural activities and helping younger students find confidence on stage. Those experiences strengthened my communication, collaboration and leadership skills.

I’m now building on that foundation through business-focused learning and practical job simulations, with a long-term ambition to turn ideas into ventures that solve real problems.
